evidence.name: Screen field: Split between media and progress
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Split between media and progress" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Split between media and progress
sections.description: Percentage of the screen's vertical space (0-100, default 50%) given to the image/text area; the rest goes to the progress area. Raise it above 50% when your image or step text needs more room, or lower it to make the progress bar more prominent. This appears only for the Image First or Chart First layouts and is hidden for the orbital Circle layout.
